segments.title: How hard can this SHRIMP punch?
segments.say: How hard can a mantis shrimp punch? Its own weight, a hundred times, or a thousand times? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: Over 1,000x its weight!
segments.say: Over a thousand times its body weight!

segments.title: So why doesn't its club BREAK?
segments.sub: **Twisted layers**, like a spiral stack of paper
segments.say: Why doesn't its club break? Twisted layers inside, like a spiral stack of paper.

segments.title: They filter the worst shock waves
segments.say: They filter out the worst shock waves.
